# Browser dependencies

`katex/` contains the unmodified KaTeX 0.16.22 browser distribution
(`katex.min.js`, `katex.min.css`, and all referenced fonts), with its MIT
license. Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.16.22.tgz

These files are kept locally so mathematical notation does not depend on
an external CDN. Quarto copies this directory into the rendered book.
